nodes.label: Sessions
nodes.description: Sessions that started in the hour
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(sessions) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Product views
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(product_views) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Carts
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(carts) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Checkouts
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(checkouts) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Payment attempts
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, provider, SUM(payment_attempts) AS value
FROM fact_payments_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Payment successes
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, provider, SUM(payment_successes) AS value
FROM fact_payments_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(orders) AS value
FROM fact_orders_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: GMV
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(gmv) AS value
FROM fact_orders_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: View rate
nodes.description: Share of sessions that view a product
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(product_views)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Cart rate
nodes.description: Share of product viewers that add to cart
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(carts)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(product_views), 0) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Checkout rate
nodes.description: Share of carts that start checkout
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(checkouts)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(carts), 0) AS value
FROM fact_funnel_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Attempt rate
nodes.description: Share of checkouts that attempt a payment

nodes.label: Payment success rate
nodes.description: Share of payment attempts that succeed
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, provider, SUM(payment_successes)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(payment_attempts), 0) AS value
FROM fact_payments_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Conversion rate
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(orders)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS value
FROM fact_orders_hourly JOIN fact_funnel_hourly USING (ts, country, platform, channel, category)
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Average order value
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, country, platform, channel, category, SUM(gmv)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0) AS value
FROM fact_orders_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Ad impressions
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_impressions) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Ad clicks
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_clicks) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Ad spend
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_spend) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Ad conversions
nodes.description: Orders attributed to an ad click
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_conversions) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Attributed GMV
nodes.description: GMV of attributed orders in EUR
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(attributed_gmv) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: Planned spend
nodes.description: Pacing plan: daily budget x expected traffic share of the hour
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, SUM(planned_spend) AS value
FROM fact_ad_plan_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: CTR
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_clicks)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(ad_impressions), 0) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: CPC
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_spend)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(ad_clicks), 0) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: CPA
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(ad_spend)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(ad_conversions), 0) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL

nodes.label: ROAS
nodes.description: Attributed GMV per EUR of spend
nodes.sql:
SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, SUM(attributed_gmv)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS value
FROM fact_ads_hourly
GROUP BY ALL
